# Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat

\\nWanting to know more? [Click here.](/camp-afro-foli-drum-dance-retreat/) \\n \\nCAMP AFRO FOLI DRUM AND DANCE RETREAT PRICING \\n

**Saturday Pass**  \\n_Includes tuition for Saturday, morning tea, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner and African Performance. No accommodation._

\\n

**Sunday Pass**  \\n_Includes tuition, morning tea and lunch for Sunday. No accommodation._

\\nThis is an no alcohol event. Please do not bring alcohol into the premise. \\n \\n_Terms and Conditions: All Camp Afro Foli Drum and Dance Retreat passes are non-refundable, non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for classes or services at a later date. Artists may be subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances._
